nativeBaseline.reference: span[role=img][aria-label] with native img[alt=''] or initials span; optional decorative aria-hidden

library: Render a single accessible image-like identity with an authored name and decorative descendant image
Provide visible fallback initials when no source or a native image load fails in React
Reuse canonical token-driven CSS for circle geometry, sizes and forced-colors presentation
Retain native img loading/decoding/source selection and expose noninteractive host ref
consumer: Supply a non-empty accurate name; provide localized initials explicitly when automatic derivation is inappropriate
Mark decorative when a nearby visible name already labels the identity
Own image URLs, privacy, availability, fetch/authentication, uploads, and user data
Provide semantic grouping and interaction in an owning Button/Link if the avatar is clickable
Native Web consumers attach an image error listener when automatic fallback is desired

notes: AvatarFallback is private; never introduce a standalone product or named public part.
Avatar image has alt empty because labeled outer host owns the name. Decorative host is aria-hidden.
Browser image-error handling is owned by React API, native Web consumers compose their own event handling.
